Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril's Space Ground Systems team builds the mission-critical software backbone that enables satellite command and control, space domain awareness, and dynamic space operations for the U.S. military and allied partners. We develop distributed backend services, APIs, and microservices that power ground C2 platforms, handling everything from satellite tasking and mission planning to high-rate telemetry processing and real-time orbital data fusion. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to join our rapidly growing Space Ground Systems team. In this role you will be responsible for all business operations for the team. Your work will vary from quick-turn operational fire-fighting, to building and redesigning processes, to leading high-impact strategic projects. This role requires you to be a trusted partner to each part of the business, and to work with and support the Space and Division leadership teams to achieve our strategic objectives.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 
 Drive day-to-day business operations for the Space Business line. This will include business planning & organization design, talent planning & people operations, real estate &facility planning, security & infrastructure compliance, proposal & legal support, and sharing the division’s narrative.

 Work with the growth team to define and synthesize the growth strategy for Space Ground Systems Business in partnership with the Space Leadership Team

 Support the growth, execution, and engineering of the business line with operational support

 Lead strategic initiatives in-line with the Business Line priorities

 Problem solve to enable the Business Line to operate as efficiently as possible and scale accordingly

 Own managing the Business Line Profit/Loss and burn rate - working closely with Anduril finance

 Build senior leader engagement and external interface strategy (e.g. conferences, press releases, partnerships)

 Build, negotiate and execute partnerships across industry

 Support Merger and Acquisition activity - identifying targets and engaging in diligence

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 10+ years of professional experience in operations

 Strong emotional intelligence and ability to solve operational problems in a way that is both data-driven and people-centric.

 High ownership with sufficient horsepower to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Solid technical aptitude and proven ability to understand technical designs and ability to work closely and effectively with engineering teams

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our HQ in Costa Mesa, CA

 Minimum 25% travel expected

 Able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 MBA or similar degree

 Experience working with engineers and bringing hardware/software products to market strongly preferred

 Experience in the Space Industry

 Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure

 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. **DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS**

*Ritchey Livestock ID* | Fort Collins, Colorado | Full-Time, Onsite

Run the Operation. Build the Team. Shape What's Next.

**This Role Is For Builders.**

**We're looking for someone who can run a great operation today—and help build the company we'll become tomorrow.**

At Ritchey Livestock ID, we believe farmers and ranchers are the unsung heroes of our world. They work long hours, in every kind of weather, doing the essential work of feeding the rest of us. They don't ask for much in return. The least we can do is get our little part right.

For more than 60 years, we've manufactured livestock identification tags that ranchers can count on. Our products may be small, but the responsibility we feel to our customers is anything but.

We're a profitable, growing American manufacturer with a loyal nationwide customer base. We've recently completed the largest facility investment in our company's history, opening a new manufacturing operation in Fort Collins, Colorado. Now we're building the people, systems, and culture to carry Ritchey into its next chapter.

**We're looking for a hands-on Director of Operations who can lead that effort—and potentially grow into a broader executive leadership role as the company evolves.**

This is not a position for someone who wants to lead from behind a desk. You'll spend meaningful time on the production floor, working alongside your managers, solving real problems, and helping people succeed.

You'll also be expected to think beyond today's production schedule: developing leaders, building systems, improving performance, and preparing Ritchey for its next stage of growth.

**The Opportunity**

You'll lead approximately 45 people across manufacturing, engraving, shipping, and related operations, working directly with our CEO.

Your mission is twofold: **Run an exceptional operation today. Build the people, processes, and accountability that make excellence repeatable tomorrow.**

You'll own performance across safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, cost, and team development.

You'll be responsible for developing department managers, improving operational systems, driving continuous improvement, and building a culture where people take pride in their work and ownership of their results.

**Your First Year: Real Challenges, Real Opportunity**

We've made a major investment in our future. Now comes the work of making that investment pay off.

Here are five challenges you'll help us tackle:

* **Strengthen our new manufacturing operation.** Continue ramping up our Fort Collins facility, improving production stability, quality, capacity, and efficiency.
* **Improve scheduling and throughput.** Build better production planning and workflows across manufacturing, engraving, and shipping to improve delivery performance and reduce bottlenecks.
* **Build systems that last.** Reduce dependence on individual employees by developing practical SOPs, standardized processes, clear performance measures, and repeatable operating routines.
* **Develop our next generation of leaders.** Coach newer managers, strengthen accountability, and build employee development practices that help great people grow.
* **Drive continuous improvement.** Use Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and practical root-cause problem-solving to reduce waste, improve productivity, and create measurable, sustainable improvements.

You'll have meaningful ownership of these challenges, the support of our leadership team, and the freedom to make a lasting impact.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for a rare combination of heart, head, and hands. Someone who can lead people, build systems, solve problems, and roll up their sleeves when the work demands it.

**What you must bring:**

* **Proven People Leadership:** Demonstrated success leading teams in a manufacturing or production environment, ideally 20 or more employees, with experience developing supervisors or managers and holding people accountable.
* **Demonstrated Systems Building:** A track record of improving processes, implementing operational improvements, and building systems that continue to work without your constant involvement.
* **High Agency & Ownership:** The judgment, initiative, work ethic, and follow-through to take responsibility for results, solve difficult problems, and lead confidently in a hands-on environment.

**What we'd love to see:**

* Experience in plastic injection molding, extrusion, or related manufacturing processes.
* Practical experience applying Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous improvement methods. Certifications are valued but not required.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, inventory management, purchasing, and quality systems.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, with an understanding of how operational decisions affect profitability.
* Experience developing managers, building teams, and helping an organization prepare for growth.

We value experience, but we're far more interested in what you've accomplished than the number of years on your résumé.

**Seasoned plastics professionals and exceptional leaders from other manufacturing environments are equally encouraged to apply.** What matters most is demonstrated leadership, systems thinking, operational judgment, and a willingness to keep learning.

***The Ritchey Way***

Our culture is built around one simple commitment: **DO RIGHT BY THE RANCH.**

Four core principles guide how we show up every day:

**ASK WHY. ASK WHAT IF.** — Learn the work. Make it better.

**MAKE THE SMALL THINGS COUNT.** — Bring care to the details, seen or unseen.

**NO SIDELINES.** — See it. Say it. Help solve it.

**BE GOOD TO WORK WITH.** — Carry your share. Be good company.

These aren't just words on a wall. They're the standards we hold ourselves and each other to. As our Director of Operations, you'll help bring *The Ritchey Way* to life through your leadership, your example, and the team you build.

**Why Ritchey?**

We're small enough that your ideas matter, but established and ambitious enough that your work can make a lasting difference. You'll have direct access to ownership, real authority to drive improvement, and a genuine opportunity to help shape the company's future.

**We're intentionally looking for someone with the potential to grow beyond operations.**

For the right individual who demonstrates exceptional leadership, business judgment, and results, this role could become a pathway toward broader company leadership, potentially including a future President or General Manager position.

That opportunity isn't guaranteed or tied to a timetable. It will be earned through performance, trust, and demonstrated ability to lead an increasingly complex business.

Most importantly, you'll be part of a team that takes pride in showing up every day for the farmers and ranchers who feed us.

**If you're a builder at heart, believe great people deserve great leadership, and want to create something you can be genuinely proud of, we'd love to meet you.**

**Brand:**

Bagel Brands

**Bagel Brands is the parent company for your favorite breakfast brands, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Bruegger's Bagels, Noah's NY Bagels, and Manhattan Bagel. We believe in the bagel and how it has the unique ability to bring people together. Our team has a standard set of values and behaviors that allow us to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. They let us laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company a little more. These are the behaviors that guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we treat our guests. We believe that there is no better way to make someone’s day than with a warm, fresh-baked bagel and a heart-felt good morning.**

**POSITION MISSION**

The Director, Operations Excellence leads the strategy, team, and discipline that make it easier for our bakery teams to obsess over our guests and deliver great results every day. This role owns the enterprise operations engineering agenda for Bagel Brands — evaluating how work gets done, designing better ways of working, and building the team needed to test, scale, and sustain change across Field Operations and Support Center teams.

* Represent Operations Excellence in senior leadership and strategic planning forums, translating field findings into enterprise decisions.

* Oversee evaluation of bakery processes, workflows, and systems to simplify work, optimize labor investments, reduce waste, and strengthen performance.

* Own the standard for future-state process design, balancing efficiency, guest experience, team member experience, and financial impact.

**Testing, Piloting & Continuous Improvement**

* Set the standard for how the organization designs and governs operational pilots before broader rollout.

* Review pilot results with senior leadership and make scale, refine, or discontinue recommendations.

* Sponsor root-cause analysis on significant recurring challenges, ensuring solutions are sustainable rather than short-term fixes.

 
 

**Labor and Inventory Analytics and Systems Optimization**

* Own labor and inventory system optimization through consistent review of program enhancements, labor/inventory performance opportunities, and cross-functional partnerships with IT, Finance, and program owners.

* Create and maintain regular reporting for Ops teams that highlights opportunities for improvement

 
 

**Project & Change Management**

* Own the portfolio of cross-functional operational excellence initiatives from problem identification through sustainment.

* Set the organization’s approach to structured change management and ensure it is applied consistently.

* Maintain enterprise-level visibility to portfolio progress, risks, and business impact.

 
 

**Team & Field Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Operations Excellence managers and professionals.

* Coach the team on problem solving, project management, and change leadership, building bench strength for future roles.

* Maintain regular presence in bakeries, partnering with Field Operations leaders to test and validate solutions.

* Identify successful practices within the bakery system and lead efforts to standardize and scale them.

 
 

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Measurement**

* Partner with Training, Technology, Marketing, Culinary/R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and Development to evaluate the impact of enterprise initiatives.

* Represent the Operations perspective in cross-functional and executive-level project governance.

* Own the measurement framework used to demonstrate whether operational improvements are delivering results.

* Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations and portfolio updates to senior Operations leadership.

 

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES (DIRECTOR / SENIOR DIRECTOR)**

* *Effective Communication:* Articulates vision and manages difficult conversations cross-functionally; communicates complex initiatives and navigates executive discussions.
* *Accountability & Ownership:* Owns budget and strategy and drives a culture of accountability; manages multi-team performance and champions data-driven decisions.
* *Adaptability & Perseverance:* Leads the department through major change and anticipates trends; drives change across functions and builds resilient teams.
* *Empowerment:* Creates space for innovation and mentors emerging leaders; designs structures for decentralized decision-making.
* *Curiosity:* Probes beyond surface issues and fosters a learning environment; benchmarks against top organizations and sponsors new ideas.
* *Self-Awareness:* Understands own leadership brand and exhibits humility; holds deep clarity on values and stays resilient under pressure.

 

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

**Required**

* 10+ years of experience in restaurant operations, operations excellence, continuous improvement, or a related discipline.

* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a team.

* Track record of leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional projects with measurable business impact.

* Strong strategic, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills.

* Strong portfolio and project management skills, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and budgets.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change at the senior leadership level without direct authority.

* Excellent executive presentation skills and ability to travel regularly to bakery locations.

 
 

**Preferred**

* Advanced experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, or comparable methodologies.

* Experience within QSR, fast casual, retail, or another high-volume, multi-unit consumer environment.

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred, or equivalent experience.

**About CAMP Systems:** 
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:** 
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:** 
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

 

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director – Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
